routine: 단어 5분(예문 소리 내어 2번) → 패턴 5분(뼈대에 내 문장 넣기) → 위를 가리고 문제 3분 → 복습 2분 → 오늘 쓸 표현 1개 골라 실제 메일에 쓰기

review.title: 복습 (11/25·11/23·11/19 표현 + 오답 2개), 영어로 먼저 써 보기

items.prompt: 승인받지 않은, 무단의 — not approved 대신
상한을 두다 — keep it under 대신
(다음 기간·목록으로) 넘기다 — move to next week 대신

items.answer: Please do not ~ without my prior approval.
I have yet to receive ~, which I asked for on ~.

items.prompt: 항목별로 나누어 적다 — write each cost 대신
(여러 건을) 하나로 모으다 — put together 대신
명확히 하다: Please ____ who enters the lot number.
우선 처리하다 — do first 대신: Please ____ the two urgent items.

cover_practice.prompt: 알아보다, 검토하다: We should e______ cheaper options before we renew the lease.
확답하다: We cannot c_____ to a delivery date until the fabric arrives.
지장을 주다: The power cut d________ production for two hours.
청구하다: The forwarder c______ us a storage fee for three days.
왜 통관이 늦어졌는지, 그리고 컨테이너가 언제 도착할지 알려 주세요. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: Please let me know what caused the customs delay and when the container will arrive.

cover_practice.prompt: 기한은 다음 주지만, 감사원은 그래도 오늘 그 파일이 필요합니다. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: Even though the deadline is next week, the auditor still needs the file today.

words.example: Since the trucking companies have no cargo insurance, we would like to explore buying it ourselves.
words.collocations: explore options / explore the possibility of ~ing

words.example: Please do not commit to any clause until I decide.
words.collocations: commit to a date / a firm commitment

words.meaning: (일정·작업에) 지장을 주다 — affect / make problems 대신
words.example: A late schedule change disrupts the outside workers and other shipments.
words.collocations: disrupt production / a disruption to the schedule

words.meaning: (요금을) 청구하다, 받다 — take money from 대신
words.example: Please check again that the clinic does not charge the worker.
words.collocations: charge the cost to the company / free of charge

patterns.meaning: ~도 마찬가지입니다 (같은 지시를 다른 대상에도 적용할 때, 문장을 반복하지 않고)
patterns.email: Please send me the draft before you send it to the company. The same applies to the other three companies.

patterns.pattern: Please let me know what caused ~ and when ~ will ~.
patterns.meaning: ~의 원인과 ~가 언제 ~될지 알려 주세요 (Why late? When finish? 를 한 문장으로)
patterns.email: Please let me know what caused the delay and when the hanging will be finished.
patterns.spoken: What held it up, and when will it be done?

patterns.meaning: ~이긴 하지만 그래도 ~합니다 (상대 말이 사실임을 인정하고 반박할 때. Even if는 가정, Even though는 사실)
patterns.email: Even though we are before the cut-off, a schedule change still disrupts other shipments.
patterns.spoken: I know we still have time, but it still causes trouble.

source: 11/25 보낸 메일(운송 계약 조항 협의·적하보험 견적 요청, 행잉 선적 준비 일정 규칙, 산재 치료비 회사 선지급 절차)에서 고름. 11/24 보낸 메일 없음, 받은 메일은 따로 읽지 않음.
